summary: EWSB Bancorp filed an 8-K disclosing authorization of up to 350,000 shares of Series A Junior Non-Voting Participating Preferred Stock via Articles Supplementary and announced consideration of a private offering of Common Stock to accredited investors as of April 1, 2026. No specific price, stake, premium, or exact terms were provided; the preferred stock would be senior to common on liquidation, non-redeemable, non-voting, and entitled to matching merger consideration and non-cumulative dividends. The filing signals possible capital-raising for a future transaction or restructuring, but lacks definitive deal terms. Watch for formal launch of the rights offering and subsequent disclosures on use of proceeds.
